headline: DeepSeek makes deep price cut permanent; little else moves
body: A light day. DeepSeek made its 75% price cut on V4-Pro permanent, escalating the AI price war. Cheaper models spread access and slightly ease Power Concentration, which nudges Libertarian Utopia up and Enslaved God down. A report that US intelligence agencies still use Claude despite a Pentagon risk label barely registered. Horizon Balance is 0.5, up 0.04.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.1 and Libertarian Utopia +0.1, both mostly from DeepSeek's permanent price cut (-0.09/+0.09).
